mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month values, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 280), the Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates, increasing the discount rate for equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 280, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5) indicates a deepening economic recession, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100 AND UNRATE > 4.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that supports long-term equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
